name: private-wealth-advisory-structured-planning
description: Produce structured JSON planning outputs for a private-wealth advisory API covering four analysis types: Roth conversion / RMD tax (roth_conversion_rmd), ILIT Crummey funding (ilit_crummey_implementation), GRAT-vs-CRAT comparison (trust_comparison), and integrated estate-liquidity action plans (estate_liquidity_action_plan). Use when a task asks for one of these analyses for a client (e.g. CLT-xxxx / test_xxx), gives a request memo plus an answer_template.json, and points to a read-only HTTP advisory API. Covers the SOP, every endpoint, conflicting-source resolution, exact enums/schema, the verified formulas, rounding, and ISO-date conventions.
